designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Pretty Rock National Wildlife Refuge by Executive Order 8659 on February 3, 1941.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS limited-interest refuges CCP, Table 4) and Pass B (American Presidency Project text and National Archives Executive Orders Disposition Table, 6 FR 770) agree on order number and date. The refuge is a limited-interest (easement) refuge on private land.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1941
FWS, Comprehensive Conservation Plan: North Dakota Limited-interest National Wildlife Refuges (2006), Table 4
